reviews_h2: What people say after we are done

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.text: I'd give them 10 stars if I could. Mr. Dupree is patient, kind, compassionate, and incredibly knowledgeable about cars. His sister, the receptionist, is compassionate and caring if you take the time to actually talk to her. I honestly look forward to renewing my inspection bc I've grown so fond of Mr. Dupree and I thoroughly enjoy talking to him and catching up on life with him after he inspects my car and we're waiting for his sister to do the paperwork. I highly recommend Dupree's Garage to anyone who enjoys taking a little extra time to get to know an amazing man.

reviews.author: Dr. Armand Serry, Sr.
reviews.text: Absolutely horrible customer service. Drove an hour from Richmond, VA after speaking to the receptionist the day before. I arrived before 8:00 AM just to be told that they were booked out for state inspections. The receptionist had a nonchalant and a “oh well” attitude. Horrible experience. A complete waste of time. DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!

reviews.author: Eric Udell
reviews.text: I came for an inspection. Have to wait in my hot car in an unshaded lot for 2.5 hours at least, only two in in line in front of me. The staff was just sitting around, no inspections were happening. After an hour with no progress, I left. I've come here before, but this is the worst. It's 100F out and my car has no A/C. The sure don't want the business very much, but since they don't do a real inspection ( lights work? You pass ) I suppose it makes sense.

reviews.author: Denita Hardy
reviews.text: Used to be a great family ran business...Same management, different service. The people are rude and unprofessional, unless they know you personally. Poor communication. Stopped going here two urs ago, fast forward to yesterday, husband had same, poor experience. Go elsewhere for your inspection, car servicing needs, you'll have a much better experience

reviews.author: Gracie Maes
reviews.text: Been going here for years .. lately always a reason not to do inspection.. wait time horrible. Go elsewhere

reviews.author: Lorrie Woodruff
reviews.text: Called ahead for a inspection was told first come , can understand that. Get there 20 minutes later one vehicle in the bay, no one working. Went to sign in , was told 3hr wait. Absolutely unprofessional.

reviews.author: Marcelle Brown
reviews.text: We started going here for our inspections years ago because they do not try to make stuff up in order to guzzle money from you. Years ago my wife and I took our vehicle to another place to have it checked it out and we watched how no one there oil change, inspection, tire repair, left without something further wrong with their vehicles it’s 3-4 customers with a problem. They worked you up in the most dishonest way but Dupree’s isn’t like that this far I have found them honest and respectful. If I can I normally do my own work but if I cannot fix an issue I might be paying them a visit,

reviews.author: Heather Noneya
reviews.text: Got the work I needed done in less than 5 minutes! Great Works ! Great Atmosphere! Great Prices! Travled all the way from NC and they helped me out!!

reviews.author: John Cooper
reviews.text: I broke down on I-95 near Emporia Virginia...alternator quit working. I called AAA and Oberry's tow truck showed up. I had searched online for a garage and read reviews for Dupree's garage. Reviews were all good so I told the tow truck to take me there. In response the driver said they weren't aaa approved and that they weren't very good. He was going to take me to their garage (Oberry's garage) where they would give me excellent service at a fair price. BIG MISTAKE!!! First off they wanted $89.00 just to look at it even though I already knew that the problem was a bad alternator. Next came the cost of repairs....$1465.00!! You've got to be kidding me! If I wanted to leave the car there it would be $40/day storage. I had the battery charged and drove the car to Dupree's garage. They had the car fixed by the next day. Total cost was $119 for an alternator and $150 for installation. I can't say enough good about Dupree's. I was 700 miles from home and they came through in a big way for me. If you break down near Emporia Va insist they take you to Dupree's and stay away from Oberry's.

reviews.author: Sharon Parker
reviews.text: Very bad customer service told me my tail was not burning and they was burning perfect also I waited in the heat for hours and still didn’t get the inspection done so I took my vehicle else where terrible never go back there and very slow service.
